integrations.how.1: Get the value from the service (the card tells you where).

outreach.ag.identityAi: Say that it's AI and it's representing me
outreach.ag.identityAiBody: When a prospect asks, the agent openly says it is an AI assistant representing you.
outreach.ag.identityFounder: Say that it's me, the founder of my company
outreach.ag.identityFounderBody: The agent always speaks as you, the founder, and never says it is AI.
outreach.ag.positioning: How your AI agents position your business against competitors
outreach.ag.positioningHint: In less than 1,000 characters, why you are better than your competitors.
